title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
author: Jiarui Yuan, Yuxin Zuo, Xiaoyu Huang, Wenbo Zhang et al.

summary: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training.
takeaways: To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training.
Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.

Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks.
